title: Deriving Critical Angle
text: At the critical angle, the refracted ray travels along the boundary (angle of refraction = 90 degrees). Using Snell's law: n1 sin(theta_c) = n2 sin(90) = n2. Therefore sin(theta_c) = n2/n1.

title: Condition for TIR
text: Total internal reflection only occurs when light travels from a denser to a less dense medium (n1 > n2), and only when the angle of incidence exceeds the critical angle.
